children: may bounce toward $3,698 per ounce, as it managed to hover above a support at $3,446.
A long-shadowed hammer formed around the support, the 261.8% projection level of a downtrend from $4,513. This bullish candlestick pattern signals a completion of a five-wave cycle from $4,148.
The peak of the wave 4 is close to $3,698, which serves as a target. A detailed study on the hourly chart reveals more fine-tuned targets and supports.
A retracement analysis on the fall from $3,690 to $3,429 marks a resistance at $3,590, which looks vulnerable, as the market is retesting it.
Immediate support is at $3,560, a break below which could trigger a fall into $3,491-$3,529 range.
